constraints: This process grants no free development, recovery, money, manpower, equipment, authority, territory or information.
It reviews active plans and standing obligations only; slow life/development/resource clocks remain authoritative for accrual.
Every material action must be instantiated in its normal domain authority before resolution.
Player intent and private knowledge boundaries remain inviolable.
goals: prevent active NPC, faction, military, institutional and economic plans from remaining inert merely because their slow background clock is not due
select lawful next actions for active autonomous owners and create exact operations/messages/events when material
reconstruction_policy: Use only active owner goals, current plans/orders, knowledge, authority, location, resources, relationships, opposition, constraints, existing process coverage and prior receipts. No missing action or outcome is reconstructed from narrative convenience.
replanning_policy: At each daily boundary and every causal wake, review active unresolved plans; continue, block, complete, fail or instantiate a supported next action. Owners with no actionable plan may return no_material_change.
safe_compaction_policy: Heartbeat reviews may compact only across intervals where no active plan becomes actionable, blocked, completed, opposed, informed, resourced or otherwise materially changed.
standing_orders: review only owners with active plans, orders, contracts, operations or unresolved commitments
load the smallest causal owners rather than every world file
wake intersecting owners immediately when an instantiated action creates contact or new information
